title: 第一卷第15章 天命灵脉不堪一击第一卷第16章 气死你个老家伙
content_zh:
;;
比斗台上，君无邪与萧旭对立而站。
萧旭的眼神很是冷酷，对台下说道：“契长老，若是失手打死了挑战者，是否会受到惩罚？”
“这个……”契长老清了清嗓子，道：“拳脚无眼，既是对决，伤人在所难免。尽量注意不要伤及性命，若不小心失手，那也是无心之过，不用受到惩罚。”
众人沉默，契长老站队也太明显了，这是告诉萧旭，就算在台上杀了君无邪也不用负责任。
萧旭满意地笑了，看着君无邪说道：“青阳城曾经第一天才，今天正好用你做踏脚石，你也算发挥了最后的剩余价……”
轰！
他话还没有说完，君无邪动了，如一头蛮兽出笼，挥动的拳头打出了空爆声。
“你！”
萧旭脸上笑容凝固，对方挥拳的刹那，那猛烈无匹的气势令他有种窒息感，仓促之间抬臂格挡。
轰的一声。
他只觉得自己的手臂像是被铁锤砸中，剧痛钻心，巨大的力量令他双脚贴着地面倒滑了十余米才站稳，垂落在腰间的手臂痉挛不止。
台下众人一脸呆滞。
什么情况？
天纵之才，无敌萧旭，竟然就被丹田破碎的君无邪一拳击退了？
“君无邪，你居然偷袭，不讲武德！”
萧旭强忍双臂的痛感，发起了反击，双掌展动之间，风声呼啸，肉眼可见的真气在掌指间流淌，这是萧家家主才有资格修炼的灵级一星下品武技——烈风掌。
“你的屁话真多。”
君无邪迎了上去，依然只有一拳。
没有使用任何武技，简单直接的一拳。

拳掌碰撞。
爆响声中，萧旭面色大变，掌指间真气崩溃，门户大开，胸膛被击中，直接倒飞出去，一口鲜血喷了出来。
众人哗然。
城主府与三大家族高层惊愕之余，目露奇光，神色不再阴沉，反而露出了看好戏的表情。
萧家众人脸色铁青，尤其是萧奇与家族高层，那表情跟舔了马桶似的。
吴大人的脸上则露出了果然如此的表情，而契长老面色难看，眼角跳个不停。
“君无邪，你彻底激怒我了！”
萧旭翻爬起来，狠狠拭去嘴角的血渍，表情有些狰狞，身上的衣衫疯狂鼓荡，气势瞬间暴增，一掌隔空打出，凝聚出一个真气手掌，猛烈向着君无邪轰杀而来。
“凝气境？！”
青阳城众势力高层都惊得站了起来，那萧旭的气势在瞬间强了一倍以上。
化气成形，这是凝气境武者才能拥有的手段！
青阳城从来没有人修炼到这个境界，年仅十八岁的萧旭做到了，这实在太可怕了，不愧是天纵之姿！
台上，君无邪眼神冷漠，催动兵意，对着真气掌印并指一划。
手指宛若锋利的刀刃，摧枯拉朽般将萧旭的掌印切割成两半。
他疾步向前，瞬间抵达萧旭面前，抬手就是一巴掌。
啪的一声，响亮的耳光声响彻全场。
萧旭被扇的横飞出去，面部高高肿起，脸上留下五道清晰的指痕。
“君无邪，你敢打我脸！”
萧旭暴怒，锵的一声！拔出了背后的剑，一抹冷冽的寒光乍现，剑气迸射而出。
灵剑！

各势力高层惊呼，萧家竟然把镇族灵兵都给了萧旭。
灵兵在萧旭的手中舞出剑花，划出的剑气宛若风刃般，攻击凌厉无比，剑剑直斩君无邪要害。

On the competition stage, Jun Wuxie and Xiao Xu stood opposite each other.
Xiao Xu's eyes were very cold and he said to the audience: "Elder Qi, if you accidentally kill the challenger, will you be punished?"
"This..." Elder Qi cleared his throat and said: "Fistes and kicks have no eyesight. Since it is a duel, injuries are inevitable. Try to be careful not to hurt people's lives. If you accidentally miss, it is an unintentional mistake and you will not be punished."
Everyone was silent. It was too obvious for Elder Qi to take sides. This was telling Xiao Xu that he would not be responsible even if he killed Jun Wuxie on the stage.
Xiao Xu smiled with satisfaction, looked at Jun Wuxie and said, "Qingyang City used to be the number one genius, and today I just want to use you as a stepping stone. You can be considered as giving full play to your remaining value..."
Boom!
Before he could finish speaking, Jun Wuxie moved, like a wild beast coming out of its cage, waving his fists and making air-explosion sounds.
"You!"
The smile on Xiao Xu's face froze. The moment the opponent punched, the fierce momentum made him feel suffocated, and he hurriedly raised his arms to block.
There was a bang.
He felt as if his arm had been hit by a hammer. The pain was excruciating. The huge force made him slide his feet against the ground for more than ten meters before he could stand still. The arm hanging down on his waist was spasming.
Everyone in the audience looked stunned.
What's going on?
Xiao Xu, a genius and invincible, was knocked back by a punch from Jun Wuxie whose Dantian was shattered?
"Jun Wuxie, you attacked me secretly and showed no martial ethics!"
Xiao Xu resisted the pain in his arms and launched a counterattack. As he moved his palms, the wind howled, and the visible energy flowed between his palms. This was the one-star low-grade spiritual martial skill that only the head of the Xiao family was qualified to practice - Gale Wind Palm.
"You talk a lot of bullshit."
Jun Wuxie rushed forward, but still only had one punch.
No martial arts were used, just a simple and direct punch.
Fists clashed.
Amid the explosion, Xiao Xu's expression changed drastically, the energy in his palms collapsed, the door opened wide, his chest was hit, he flew backwards, and a mouthful of blood spurted out.
Everyone was in an uproar.
The top officials of the City Lord's Mansion and the three major families were astonished, and their eyes shone with strange light. Their expressions were no longer gloomy, but showed expressions of watching a good show.
The faces of everyone in the Xiao family were ashen, especially Xiao Qi and the top family officials, whose expressions looked as if they had licked the toilet.
Master Wu's face showed a true expression, while Elder Qi's expression was ugly, and the corners of his eyes were twitching.
"Jun Wuxie, you have completely angered me!"
Xiao Xu got up and wiped the blood from the corners of his mouth with a ferocious expression. The clothes on his body were fluttering wildly, and his aura suddenly increased. He punched out a palm from the air, condensed a palm of true energy, and violently blasted towards Jun Wuxie.
"Qi Condensation Realm?!"
All the high-ranking officials in Qingyang City stood up in shock, and Xiao Xu's momentum more than doubled in an instant.
Transforming gas into shape is a method only available to Qi Condensation Realm warriors!
No one in Qingyang City has ever cultivated to this level. Xiao Xu, who is only 18 years old, has achieved it. This is really terrifying, and he is worthy of being a genius!
On the stage, Jun Wuxie's eyes were cold, he mobilized his military will, and pointed at the Zhenqi palm seals.
The fingers were like sharp blades, cutting Xiao Xu's palm print in half.
He stepped forward quickly and arrived in front of Xiao Xu in an instant. He raised his hand and slapped him.
With a snap, a loud slap echoed throughout the audience.
Xiao Xu was slapped and flew away. His face was swollen and there were five clear finger marks on his face.
"Jun Wuxie, how dare you slap me in the face!"
Xiao Xu was furious and shouted! Pulling out the sword from behind, a cold light suddenly appeared, and sword energy burst out.
Spirit sword!
The top leaders of various forces exclaimed that the Xiao family actually gave all the spiritual soldiers of the town to Xiao Xu.
The spirit soldier danced the sword flower in Xiao Xu's hand, and the sword energy drawn out was like a wind blade. The attack was extremely fierce, and the sword cut directly into Jun Wuxie's vitals.
